newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.10 cent per lb. Lower cash beef prices Thursday plus talk packers will have contract cattle available June 1.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady-0.10 cent lower. Expected lower CME live cattle and higher CBOT corn futures bearish for feeders.
LEAN HOGS - steady - 0.20 cent lower. Lower pork prices Thursday and talk of $0.50 to $1.00 per cwt lower cash hogs bearish. However, shortcovering may lift nearby futures early.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.20 to up 0.20 cent. Follow-through selling likely at outset. However, shortcovering ahead of weekend may produce early gains.
